title: The Shift From Coding to Context Orchestration
excerpt: For over a quarter of a century, software engineering treated code syntax as its primary unit of leverage. As production systems transition to generative runtime engines, the high-leverage skill moves entirely into structural prompt composition, token safety boundaries, and validation pipeline tooling.

title: Token Window Economics: Managing System Context Headers
excerpt: An architectural review analyzing how long-tail conversation data, multi-agent overhead parameters, and strict JSON output schema rules quickly impact inference latency budgets inside production enterprise ecosystems.
